Name: REAPER Control
Description: Execute REAPER actions directly from Stream Deck over REAPER's built-in web interface.

com.stephenschappler.reaper.runaction.Name: Run Action
com.stephenschappler.reaper.runaction.Tooltip: Runs a REAPER action (numeric or named command ID) directly, without a hotkey.

com.stephenschappler.reaper.transport.Name: Transport
com.stephenschappler.reaper.transport.Tooltip: Play, stop, pause, record, repeat, or seek - with live state feedback from REAPER.

com.stephenschappler.reaper.track.Name: Track Control
com.stephenschappler.reaper.track.Tooltip: Mute, solo, record-arm, or select a track - with live state feedback from REAPER.

Localization.setup.title: Connect to REAPER
Localization.setup.step1: In REAPER, open Options → Preferences → Control/OSC/web
Localization.setup.step2: Click Add, then choose Web browser interface
Localization.setup.step3: Set the port to 8080 (or any port - just match it below)
Localization.setup.step4: Tick Run on startup, then click OK
Localization.setup.reaperMustBeRunning: REAPER must be running for Stream Deck keys to work.
Localization.setup.credentialsHint: REAPER's web interface sends credentials unencrypted. Only use this over a network you trust.
Localization.runaction.unrecognizedId: This ID isn't in your action list. It may still work - import your action list to confirm.
Localization.runaction.importStep1: In REAPER, open the Actions window
Localization.runaction.importStep2: Find and run SWS/S&M: Dump action list (all actions)
Localization.runaction.importStep3: Click Import my action list below and select the saved file
Localization.runaction.importScopeHint: Only Main-section actions are imported - other sections can't be triggered over REAPER's web interface.
